theorems.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn m) (T : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn n), (∀ (w : Rn m) (v : Rn n), inner ℝ (T w) v = inner ℝ w (L v)) → ∀ w : Rn m, T w = ∑ i : Fin n, inner ℝ (L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) w • EuclideanSpace.single i 1
